name: @kanche/client
description: The Kanche app: PixiJS renderer, shipped to Android and iOS through Capacitor and to the web.

scripts.e2e: vite build --mode e2e --outDir dist-e2e && playwright test
scripts.android:debug: vite build --mode debug && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: vite build --mode debug && cap sync ios
